name: UI Layer
description: React components for game selection, display, and interaction including game cards, header, stats modal, game viewer, and all six game implementations (Breakout, Flappy, 2048, Minesweeper, Simon, Snake).

name: State & Data Layer
description: Core application state management (App.tsx), shared type definitions (types.ts), and central game catalog data (gamesData.ts) defining all game metadata, categories, and achievements.

name: Utility Layer
description: Cross-cutting utilities including localStorage persistence for user statistics (storage.ts) and Web Audio API wrapper for procedural sound effects (audio.ts).

name: Entry Point
description: Application bootstrap (main.tsx), HTML entry point (index.html), and global stylesheet importing Tailwind CSS (index.css).

name: Configuration
description: Project build and runtime configuration including package.json with React 19 and Vite dependencies, TypeScript compiler settings, Vite config with React and Tailwind plugins, and environment variable template.

name: Metadata
description: Application metadata manifest defining the ArcadeSphere game collection name, description, frame permissions, and major capabilities.

name: Tooling
description: Understand Anything analysis ignore file defining exclusion patterns for codebase analysis.
